description: Deterministic, provider-free host-executor permit conformance profile. A harness is certifiable only when every required case passes; deliberate negatives must fail the broken mock.

required_cases.summary: Valid permit + matching host capabilities is accepted.
Host missing a required enforcement capability is refused.
Host context executor must match the signed permit.
Requesting harness must match the signed permit.
Canonical arguments digest must match the signed permit.
Target selectors must match the signed permit.
Observed preconditions must match immutable preconditions.
Untrusted key id is refused (issuer may still match).
Same idempotency key returns the same redemption without double consume (one-invocation permit).
Host execution evidence validates schema and terminal rules.
A deliberately broken mock fails every negative case (proves the suite is not vacuous).
